reason: My Indian bank will still call me or ask me to come in, so I don't see what this saves me. I don't hand my savings to a company I've never heard of, even with a registration number.
objection: A new company I don't know would be sitting between me and my savings. I only trust the big banks, and my Indian bank will still want to talk to me.
would_change_my_mind: If my Indian bank's NRI desk or my accountant told me to use it, or if a big Canadian bank offered the same service.
